english.title: Fail to inform Natural Resources Wales when carrying on activities of dead/bankrupt/incapacitated packaging producer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person carrying on the activities of a producer of packaging waste that had

(A)_[died,]_
(B)_[become bankrupt,]_
(C)_[become incapacitated,]_

failed, within 28 days of commencing those activities, to inform Natural Resources Wales in writing of the

(D)_[date of death]_
(E)_[date of bankruptcy]_
(F)_[nature of the incapacity]_

and the date on which you began carrying on the activities
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(3) and 28(1) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
